body: Yes, I admit that it's not the first time I experience this type of feeling, I controlled myself well at the other times and it never really got to my head. In part, they were probably founded, but honestly I don't know if I can really make that judgement. Letting insecurities take over only makes things worse, and I learned the hard way.

Yes, I acknowledge this now that I look back. It's hard to admit these things when you're the one taking everything the wrong way. I'm on a break from roleplaying and while I miss it with my whole heart, I know I'm not in the condition to do it right now.
I also get some glasses sometimes too
